analysis: The trial completed successfully, but pinned-host macro validation HR@10 fell from the reported prior GRU result of 0.5737 to 0.5363, a decline of 0.0374. Category HR@10 was 0.565 for Movies_and_TV, 0.575 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.415 for Electronics, and 0.590 for CDs_and_Vinyl. Electronics declined from the reported prior 0.435, so this experiment did not support the proposed benefit of added local order modeling. The result does not establish why performance worsened: the residual can change during training, and adding layers also changes initialization RNG consumption for subsequent parameters. The supplied host result does not report training curves or selected epochs, so convergence and overfitting cannot be assessed. Recorded GPU allocation was 219.96 seconds.
code_summary: Trained one independent model per category with a tied item embedding, input LayerNorm, causal width-3 convolution with two-position left padding, GELU, and a zero-initialized linear residual projection. Padding is masked before and after the residual block. Dropout feeds a two-layer 96-dimensional GRU, followed by linear projection, LayerNorm, normalized embedding scores, learned scale, and item bias. Training retains eight target-rejected negatives and positive/negative softplus loss. Checkpoint selection uses validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 tie-breaking and 25-epoch patience. The generated predictor strictly loads one selected architecture-tagged checkpoint per category and uses the last valid state with matching truncation and right-padding. No ensemble or separately fitted auxiliary scorer is used.
